faithful.instructions: Does the Lean statement encode EXACTLY the cited mathematical fact, no stronger?
criteria: level 0: it is stronger than the source (over-claims)
level 1: subtle mismatch in side conditions
level 2: faithful up to harmless reformulation

criteria.coprime: coprimality convention (pairwise vs gcd of all three, or 3z vs z)
criteria.exponent: exponent range (n>=4 vs prime, composite handling)

legend.0: level 0: it is stronger than the source (over-claims)

legend.2: level 2: faithful up to harmless reformulation
